source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 251 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 251.

PD 251.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 251 was established by Ordinance No. 19321, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 8, 1986. Ordinance No. 19321 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19321 was amended by Ordinance No. 19428, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 17, 1986; Ordinance No. 21015, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 14, 1991; and Ordinance No. 25499, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 25, 2004. Ordinance No. 25499 amended Ordinances Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19321; 19428; 19455; 21015; 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 251 is established on property generally located at the north corner of Lake Highlands Drive and Tiffany Way. The size of PD 251 is approximately 3.15 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19321; 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plans (Exhibit 251A). The two residential structures shown on the development plans may not be expanded or divided to increase the density. In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plans, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.105. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 251B). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.106. PERMITTED USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are a private school for the instruction of learning disabled students, and R-7.5(A) Single Family District uses. The two residential structures shown on the development plans do not need to be on individually platted lots. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

For a private school, maximum permitted floor area is 21,000 square feet for the school building, and 25,000 square feet for the academic and fine arts center. For all other uses, there is no maximum floor area. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.109. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

For a private school, maximum lot coverage is 35 percent. For residential structures, maximum lot coverage is 45 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground structures are not. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.110. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height for all structures is 30 feet, except that the maximum height for the academic and fine arts center shown on the development plans is 39 feet. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.111. MINIMUM SETBACKS.

For a private school, setbacks must comply with those shown on the development plans. For all other uses, minimum setbacks must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

For a private school, off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development plans and as described in the traffic management plan (Exhibit 251C). For all other uses, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Parking may be provided in the required front yards along Buckner Boulevard and Lake Highlands Drive as shown on the development plans. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Drive
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.113. DRIVE.

For a private school, a student drop-off lane must be provided as shown on the development plans. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Screening
Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.115. FENCING.

For a private school, fencing must be provided in the location shown on the development plans. For a private school, the maximum height for a fence in the required front yard is six feet. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.116. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.117. INGRESS AND EGRESS.

For a private school, ingress to and egress from the Property must comply with the traffic management plan. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.118. SIGNS.

(a) Except as otherwise provided, all signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.”

(b) One monument sign is allowed at the location shown on the development plans. The monument sign must not have internal lighting or a changeable message. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Enrollment
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.119. ENROLLMENT.

Maximum enrollment in a private school is 210 full-time students. (Ord. 26576)

sections.title: Traffic Management Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.120. TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PLAN.

The traffic management plan must be revised by February 14, 2010, and at three-year intervals thereafter. (Ord. 26576)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.121. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.122. PAVING.

(a) All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.123. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25499; 25711; 26576)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-251.124. ZONING MAP.

PD 251 is located on Zoning Map No. G-9. (Ord. Nos. 19321; 25711; 26576)
